BusinessRule: Users authenticate with email & password; JWT issued with companyId and role
Refresh token rotation; reuse detection triggers token revocation
Endpoints fail-closed unless explicit @Roles(...) or @AnyAuthenticatedRole() declared
User from Company A can never view, mutate, or export records of Company B
Physical database prevents linking Lead or Policy to Contact of another company
TP premium strictly follows IRDAI statutory CC slabs (1000cc, 1500cc, >1500cc)
NCB advances 0% -> 20% -> 25% -> 35% -> 45% -> 50% only on claim-free policy
CPA is mandatory unless valid existing PA policy waiver is declared
Inspection mandatory if previous policy expired >90 days or break-in detected
Inspection requires 7 mandatory photographic perspectives before approval
Policy can only be issued once per paid quotation; concurrent calls return 409
Premium calculations must use exact rational rounding without floating error
Claims can only be filed against active policies within valid coverage period
Settled and closed claims cannot have approved amounts or surveyors modified
Receipt issuance must generate persistent server document and ledger link
Commission accrued to issuing agent based on insurer product commission slab
Active policies expiring within 60 days automatically enrolled into renewal queue
Incoming webhooks must be cryptographically verified; unsigned rejected
Report exports must strictly filter records by authenticated caller companyId
Liveness and readiness probes verify PostgreSQL, Redis, Memory, and Disk
